gaps.explanation: Proprietary funds statement of revenues, expenses and changes in net position - modified cash basis (p7) prints Water, Sewer and Ambulance enterprise fund columns (Ambulance all zero this year apart from the restatement); no business-type lines in detail[]. Statement receipts[] = Sales + Other revenue + Interest income. Water: 190,995 + 800 + 2,471 = 194,266; Sewer: 103,833 + 1,319 = 105,152. 194,266 + 105,152 = 299,418 = statement total.
